operationParameters.description: Completeness verdict per CDC-fed table, kept by mssql-cdc-pyspark: one row per table. Gate downstream work on finalized_until, e.g. with finalization.is_final().

metaData.description: Completeness verdict per CDC-fed table, kept by mssql-cdc-pyspark: one row per table. Gate downstream work on finalized_until, e.g. with finalization.is_final().
metaData.schemaString: {"type":"struct","fields":[{"name":"table_name","type":"string","nullable":true,"metadata":{"comment":"The table this verdict is about: the name passed to finalization.advance(), usually the target table. One row per table."}},{"name":"finalized_until","type":"timestamp_ntz","nullable":true,"metadata":{"comment":"The verdict, UTC. Every period that ends at or before this instant is complete in the table: no source commit at or before it can still arrive. It only moves forward. A consumer of the period [start, end) waits for finalized_until >= end."}},{"name":"end_lsn","type":"string","nullable":true,"metadata":{"comment":"Source commit LSN (0x + 20 hex) of the batch end that last moved the verdict: how far the source had been read and committed to the table."}},{"name":"end_commit_ts","type":"timestamp_ntz","nullable":true,"metadata":{"comment":"Commit time of end_lsn, UTC. finalized_until is this instant truncated to the period (an hour by default), because transactions sharing this exact commit time may still be arriving."}},{"name":"updated_at","type":"timestamp_ntz","nullable":true,"metadata":{"comment":"When the verdict last moved, UTC."}},{"name":"applied_lsn","type":"string","nullable":true,"metadata":{"comment":"Tables built by mssql_cdc.apply_changes: the highest source commit LSN (0x + 20 hex) of the bronze changes applied to the table; the next call reads the changes after it. NULL for other tables."}},{"name":"snapshot_lsn","type":"string","nullable":true,"metadata":{"comment":"Tables built by mssql_cdc.apply_changes: the LSN of the bronze snapshot the table was last rebuilt from; a newer snapshot rebuilds it. NULL for other tables and before the first snapshot."}}]}
